D: A big-hearted teenager in 1962 Baltimore dances her way onto a TV show and fights to integrate it.
P: Serve the snacks when the Corny Collins Show comes on the TV.
S: Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon and tartare.
dancing to the Corny Collins Show after school

Saucy beef mince simmered with tomato, mustard and brown sugar, piled on soft slider buns with melted cheese and crunchy dill pickles. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum. Stir in 150ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Toast 12 slider buns, add a slice of cheese, spoon on the beef and top with pickles.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, smoked paprika and chives on top.
M: Beef topside rubbed with salt, pepper, garlic and paprika, grilled hot until charred outside and rare inside, sliced thin, piled on rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce.
Edna feeding the family in their little rowhouse

Buttermilk fried chicken with a crunchy craggy crust, honey hot sauce, creamy mash and gravy, buttered corn and a soft dinner roll. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt overnight. Dredge in 250g flour with paprika, garlic powder and pepper, drizzling a little buttermilk into the flour for crags. Fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes to 75C inside. Mix 3 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Serve with mash, gravy from 300ml stock, buttered corn cobs and dinner rolls.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with a tall swirl of buttercream piped into a beehive, pastel sprinkles.
K: Har-De-Har Hut black and white malts
Wilbur's joke shop and a 1962 Baltimore soda fountain

Vanilla ice cream blended thick with malted milk powder and a ribbon of chocolate sauce, topped with whipped cream and a cherry. Blend 8 scoops of vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Drizzle chocolate sauce down the inside of 4 tall chilled glasses. Pour in the shake, swirl a little more chocolate sauce through the top and finish with whipped cream and a cherry.

s.how: Mix 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayonnaise, an egg, a teaspoon of Dijon, a pinch of paprika and half a cup of breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 small cakes and chill for 30 minutes. Pan-fry in butter until golden on both sides and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Halve and whip the yolks with mayonnaise, yellow mustard and a dash of hot sauce until smooth. Pipe back into the whites, dust with smoked paprika and finish with snipped chives.

m.how: Rub a 1kg piece of beef topside with salt, cracked pepper, garlic powder and smoked paprika. Grill over high heat, turning, until charred outside and rare inside. Rest, slice paper thin and pile onto bread rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in cases at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter and icing sugar with a drop of colouring and pipe tall beehive swirls on top. Finish with pastel sprinkles.
